description: Registers a user with an app client and requests a user name, password, and user attributes in the user pool.

incidents.description: On the hunt for ARTEX: understanding agentic attacks in AWS environments

securityImplications: Attackers might use SignUp to self-register an account in a user pool that allows public sign-up, obtaining authenticated tokens that they can exchange for AWS credentials through an identity pool or use against the application's APIs.
